'''CZ-33''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine programmed]] [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Scarlet Hark]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Hark noted that she did not own the droid, and he served her on his own accord.
